blurb: ATHA Hot Yoga offers a variety of yoga classes in heated environments, including classic 26 & 2 sequence, Flow, Hatha, Ladder, Mobility, Power, Restorative, Yin, and Yoga Nidra. They provide in-person yoga teacher training in Cancun, Mexico, focusing on real-world teaching skills, philosophy, anatomy, and sequencing. The studio emphasizes presence, authenticity, transformation, and harmony in yoga practice.
extraNote: Unlimited Access Membership can be paused for vacations and travel · Studio located at #216, 2031 33rd Ave SW, Calgary, AB, with free underground parking and access via the Shoppes of Marda Loop.
